summary: Symmetric TSP 3-opt searches reconnections after three pairwise nonadjacent edge cuts.
description: Input is a finite symmetric matrix and a complete open tour. Return one strict best improvement or a copy of the input when no constructed neighbor improves it.

Keep one fragment oriented and try both orders and orientations of the other two. The enumeration includes 2-opt-equivalent reconnections and does not cut adjacent edges. Recomputing full lengths gives quartic time. Fewer than six vertices leave the tour unchanged.
